next.reason: 1985: "the indicator area of the introduced line contains the same character as the line on which the text being replaced begins"; 2023: "GR-7.2.3.4-11: The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format.". 2023 makes COPY's resultant text logical free-form, which has no indicator area or continuation lines. The rule on indicator content and hyphen continuation of introduced lines is gone.
